##: Note: taskslinger.net may hang Windows PowerShell 5.1 (schannel vs Cloudflare). Scoop under 5.1 can stall on install/update — use PowerShell 7 (pwsh). Site serves no checksum files; hashes are verified per release at packaging time.
description: Native Windows task manager replacement built in C/Win32 with a custom Direct3D UI. Process, performance, services, startup, and connection monitoring with fast startup and no telemetry.
notes: Free beta. A paid perpetual license is available at https://taskslinger.net/buy/.
